title: The Invisible Hand of Physics: When Video Diffusion Models Know More Than They Show
abstract: arXiv:2606.05328v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern video diffusion models generate increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, motivating their use as candidate world simulators. Yet it remains unclear whether these models internally encode physical structure, or merely reproduce motion patterns seen during training. We study this question by probing video diffusion models along latent trajectories corresponding to real videos with known physical plausibility. To obtain such trajectories, we approximately invert the deterministic sampling process by integrating the learned velocity field backward from a clean video latent to noise, giving access to the model's intermediate states and attention maps. translated_title: 物理学的无形之手：当视频扩散模型知道的比它们展示的更多时
translated_abstract: 现代视频扩散模型能够生成越来越逼真且时间上连贯的视频，这促使它们被用作候选的世界模拟器。然而，这些模型究竟是在内部编码了物理结构，还是仅仅复现了训练期间见过的运动模式，目前仍不清楚。我们通过在对应于具有已知物理合理性真实视频的潜空间轨迹上探测视频扩散模型来研究这一问题。为了获得这些轨迹，我们通过将学习到的速度场从干净的视频潜表示反向积分至噪声，近似地逆转确定性采样过程，从而获得模型的中间状态和注意力图。利用这些恢复的轨迹，我们证明物理合理性可以从扩散Transformer的状态中被线性解码出来，在IntPhys和InfLevel数据集上达到约81.27%的平均准确率，并优于专用的表征学习基线方法（如……
tldr: 该论文通过逆转扩散采样过程恢复模型内部轨迹，首次证明视频扩散模型内部确实线性编码了物理合理性信息，其可从扩散Transformer状态中以约81.27%的准确率解码出来，超越了专用表征学习基线。
en_tdlr: By inverting the diffusion sampling process to recover internal trajectories, this paper shows that video diffusion models linearly encode physical plausibility, decodable from diffusion transformer states with ~81.27% accuracy, outperforming dedicated representation-learning baselines.
